rationale: go-jose JWK RSA parsing DoS. The care-caddy binary carries github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v3 v3.0.5 only through caddypki (smallstep/certificates, go.step.sm/crypto); no fixed v3 release exists. The deployed Caddyfile uses no acme_server, pki app or internal issuer, so that JWK parsing is not reachable. go-jose/v4 is pinned to the fixed 4.1.6. ADR-0041 addendum of 28 October 2026.

zlib1g 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+b1 in the API distroless Debian 13 runtime; Debian has no fixed package yet (status affected). The flaw is in gz_vacate() of the gzFile write API. Node.js links its own bundled zlib (no libz.so dependency); libcrypto links the system libz only for compress/uncompress and never calls the gzFile API, so the vulnerable path is not reachable. ADR-0057 addendum of 7 November 2026.

Reported against zlib1g 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+b1 in the API distroless Debian 13 runtime with no fixed package; the advisory title describes a webpack-dev-middleware path traversal, a dev-server package that is not in the runtime image. Treated as a feed mis-attribution until the record is corrected or Debian ships a fix. ADR-0057 addendum of 7 November 2026.
